subject: GCP co-sell inquiry — Acme Health joint intake and kickoff
messages:
From: Emma Price <emma.price@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell inquiry — Acme Health joint intake and kickoff

Hi Mina + team,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier this morning — following up with a short summary of what Acme needs and a few asks so we can get a GCP co-sell kickoff on the calendar. We're a digital health startup (payer-facing analytics) evaluating Redwood for inference on de-identified clinical summaries. High level:

- Target: production rollout H1 2028, initial scope ~5M tokens/month.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 evidence and a data retention / access controls discussion.
- Marketplace: interest in listing on GCP Marketplace + co-sell engagement.

Action items from our side: signed NDA attached (NDA_Acme_signed.pdf) and a short intake sheet (I can fill if helpful). From you, can we get:

1) A short checklist of marketplace readiness items (pricing model, listing owner, support SLAs).
2) A reliable contact for technical onboarding (networking and VPC questions).
3) Suggested times for a 30-min kickoff with the GCP partner manager.

We'd like to move quickly — available next week Tue/Thu afternoons PT.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Price | Head of Platform, Acme Health
emma.price@acmehealth.com | +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: NDA_Acme_signed.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell inquiry — Acme Health joint intake and kickoff

Emma — thanks for the overview and for the NDA. Appreciate the clarity on timeline. Looping in our GCP partner lead (Vanessa) and our PM (Karthik) so we can land next steps.

Quick responses and proposed next steps:

- Marketplace readiness checklist: I'll attach an initial intake workbook (acme_intake_v1.xlsx) covering pricing, support level, listing contacts, and required artifacts (SOC2, privacy addendum, sample SLA). Please fill the "expected ARR" and "support tier" fields — that helps GCP qualification.
- Technical contact: who on your side owns networking/VPC? If you send a name + email we’ll include them on the kickoff invite so we can cover firewall rules and ingress patterns.
- Kickoff: propose Wed 10/6 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu 10/7 14:00–14:30 PT. Vanessa, Karthik — can you confirm availability?

Operational asks for Redwood/GCP:
- Vanessa: confirm whether we should run a canary listing (private listing + co-sell) or go straight to public listing.
- Karthik: please flag any outstanding product blockers for Marketplace listing (e.g., billing integration, meter types).

If helpful I can prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) one-pager before the kickoff.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0199

Attachment: acme_intake_v1.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Emma Price <emma.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell inquiry — Acme Health joint intake and kickoff

Thanks Mina and Emma — I can join the kickoff. Quick notes from the GCP partner manager perspective:

- Recommendation: start with a private (canary) listing + co-sell. That lets us validate billing/metering and preserve a short sales motion while we complete compliance artifacts.
- Marketplace checklist: support SLA, pricing type (flat subscription vs metered token usage), listing owner (assign to Karthik), technical contact for VPC peering or secure ingress (assign to Acme's network lead). I've attached our handshake checklist for co-sell intake.
- Docs we will need before public listing: signed SOC2 report (or evidence of SOC2 in progress), privacy data flow diagram, sample EULA/terms mapping.

Proposed owner list:
- Listing owner (GCP ops): Karthik Iyer
- Redwood legal/compliance: Mina (coord)
- Acme technical lead: Emma (please confirm
  who this is)
- GCP PM: pm-gcp@google.com (cc'd on upcoming invite)

Availability: Wed 10/6 11:00 PT works for me — holding that slot tentatively.

Vanessa Ortiz
GCP Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: handshake_checklist.pdf

From: GCP Partner Manager <pm-gcp@google.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Emma Price <emma.price@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell inquiry — Acme Health joint intake and kickoff

Hi all — thanks for the context, and welcome Acme. I can join the kickoffs and help run the Marketplace intake. A few housekeeping items from GCP side:

1) Please confirm a technical contact for network/VPC and the email we should use for the listing owner.
2) For the private listing we'll need: (a) the intake spreadsheet completed, (b) the billing account ID (placeholder OK for kickoff), (c) draft pricing (subscription or metered).
3) Compliance artifacts: SOC2 report or attestation to be uploaded to our intake portal (I can share the link during the call).

I sent a calendar invite for Wed 10/6 11:00–11:30 PT (30 min). If you prefer Thu 10/7 14:00 PT, accept that one instead — I left both tentative.

Emma — who's your technical lead (name + email)? If you can reply here I'll add them to the invite.

Best,
Alex Kim
GCP Partner Manager
pm-gcp@google.com

Links and references:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421
- Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhIJk
